title.en: A language map opens a door—and shows the limits of its data
title.zh: 语言地图打开一扇门，也显出数据的边界

summary.en: Google’s November9LanguageExplorer report links a museum installation to an inspectable metadata resource with uneven coverage and distinct source licenses.
summary.zh: Google11月9日介绍的LanguageExplorer，将博物馆展示与可检查的语言元数据连接起来，同时保留覆盖差异及来源许可的边界。

title.en: Chandra finds a clue to a surviving star’s recurring outbursts
title.zh: Chandra找到恒星反复爆发背后的隐藏线索

summary.en: Timed X-rays support a compact companion behind AT2016blu’s roughly113-day optical eruptions; its exact nature remains open.
summary.zh: 定时X射线观测支持致密伴星驱动AT2016blu约113天一次的可见光爆发，伴星具体类型仍待厘清。
